items.title: Approve and adopt the General Manager’s finding that ABB Medium Voltage Variable-Frequency Drives product is necessary to match existing products used at SFPUC Wastewater Enterprise facilities; and authorize the General Manager to prescribe ABB Medium Voltage Variable-Frequency Drives for Contract No. WW- 767, Southeast Water Pollution Control Plant Booster Station Interim Improvements, contract documents in conformance with San Francisco Administrative Code Section 6.73(e)(1) and Public Contract Code Section 3400(c). This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.text: Authorize the issuance of up to $1.53 billion of Water Revenue Bonds, Sub-Series D Bonds (Regional Water & Local Water) and 2025 Sub-Series E Bonds (Hetch Hetchy Water) to fund the costs of water enterprise capital projects and to retire commercial paper up to $474 million; and 2025 Sub-Series F to refund certain outstanding Water SFPUC MAY 27, 2025 MEETING MINUTES Revenue Bonds originally issued as Build America Bonds (BABs) up to $1.056 billion (collectively, the 2025 Water Bonds); delegate to the General Manager authorization to appoint underwriters and enter into one or more bond purchase contracts with underwriters selected from the City’s pool of pre-qualified underwriters through a competitive procurement process and in accordance with the City’s policies and procedures with respect thereto, subject to the limits on underwriters’ compensation set forth in the resolution.
